title: Kielbasa Stir Fry
description: A quick and easy Chinese-inspired stir fry using kielbasa sausage. This dish combines the flavors of Asia with a Polish twist, making for a unique and tasty meal.
instructions: Heat coconut oil in a large skillet or wok over medium-high heat.
Add sliced ginger and minced garlic and cook for 1 minute.
Add broccoli and cook for 2-3 minutes, or until tender.
Add kielbasa sausage and cook for 2-3 minutes, or until browned.
In a small bowl, whisk together soy sauce, honey, and sesame seeds.
Pour the sauce over the kielbasa and broccoli mixture, and stir to coat.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
Serve hot over rice or noodles, if desired.
